_howToEdit: To add a photo, put the image (.webp or .jpg, ideally at least 1200px wide) in public/gallery/ and add an entry to the right section's photos list, e.g. { "file": "oasis-prototype.webp", "alt": "What the photo shows, for screen readers", "caption": "Optional short caption" }. Use "description" for a short line of text under the section heading. Only publish photos everyone in them has agreed to.
